name: @senryo/arcade
description: The arcade's runs as both apps play them (R7.1–R7.3, R7.6): Line Rider's sled and Candle Hop's coin as loop drivers — input, the recorded trace, the feel (cues and haptics, injected) and the drawing, onto a minimal 2D canvas the web's canvas and the phone's Skia recorder both satisfy. No react-native, no react-dom.
